title: Pi flashing: discover SSH hosts with rustscan, not nmap
objective: The Pi flash/discovery scripts find SSH hosts on the LAN with `rustscan -a <net> -p 22 -g`, install/check for rustscan instead of nmap, and rustscan is configured (scripts = "None") so it never pipes into nmap, which the pacman wrapper blocks.
acceptance_criteria: No nmap references remain in the Pi flashing scripts and rpi_nc_deps checks for rustscan (test_pi_discovery_rustscan.sh)
out_of_scope: The pacman nmap block and /usr/local/bin/nmap shim (digital-wellbeing repo)
Live scan of a real LAN
